q1_issues.issue: The modifier genus (Inheritance first_year_apprentice first_year) is not licensed: 'first-year' is a relational / rank modifier that fails the stated predication test ('*the apprentice is first-year'), the same case as 'assistant secretary', which keeps only the head genus.

notes: The exposed modifier is also a two-word symbol (first_year), which decompose-once-to-single-word-lemmas would never produce. The name symbol, the head genus (Inheritance first_year_apprentice apprentice) and the individual's (Member coraline_ash first_year_apprentice) are all correct.
